summary: Queries a named registry value under HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Direct3D. Opens the Direct3D subkey, reads the value lpValueName into lpData, closes the key, and returns TRUE only when the open and query both succeed (ERROR_SUCCESS) and the stored registry type Type equals the expected type parameter a1; otherwise returns FALSE.

local_names.Type: registry value type returned by RegQueryValueExA
local_names.result: BOOL accumulator, 0 unless the success+type-match guard passes

operations.description: Call RegOpenKeyA(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, SubKey, &phkResult); only if it returns ERROR_SUCCESS (0) continue into the query path, otherwise skip to the final return of result (FALSE).
RegQueryValueExA(phkResult, lpValueName, 0, &Type, lpData, &cbData); store the LSTATUS result in v4.
RegCloseKey(phkResult) after the value query completes.
If v4 == ERROR_SUCCESS (0) and Type == a1, return 1 (TRUE).
Return result, which is 0 (FALSE) unless the success and type-match guard passed.

unresolved: The caller sub_50FEA7 (0x0050FEA7) uses this query, but the owning object and the set of registry values the caller reads are not established by this packet.
Parameter a1 is the expected registry type only; the intended type constant and the meaning of the queried value are caller-side and unresolved here.
